notes: S through C must come from the curated Idol Ranking 2025 mapping file, not from interpolation.
Groups absent from the curated ranking file may only be inferred into D, E, or F.
B and C are only assigned manually, not from interpolation.
Popularity and fans from idolsdiagram.com are Spotify Popularity and Spotify Followers.
Group x_followers is the sum of active members' idol x_followers (not Spotify). Do not mirror fans into x_followers.
Inactive groups (ended before opening, formed after opening, or no active members at opening) use letter_tier I and are not score-evaluated.

inference.effective_score_formula: inferred D/E/F from Spotify fans (groups.fans); impute max(500, popularity*500) if fans missing
inference.d_floor_source: minimum Spotify fans among curated bottom-of-D anchors (群青の世界, ドラマチックレコード)
